dedupe_keys.name: indpensim 100 batch industrial scale penicillin fermentation simulation data with raman spectroscopy

description: This dataset holds 100 batches generated with IndPenSim, a mathematical simulation of a 100,000 litre industrial penicillin fermentation. The Mendeley Data record says IndPenSim was the first simulation to include a realistic simulated Raman spectroscopy device, for developing and testing advanced control in biotechnology plants, and that the batches carry all process and Raman measurements (about 2.5 GB) for big data analytics and machine learning in the biopharmaceutical industry; the simulation is documented on the IndPenSim website. It was published on 8 October 2019 (version 2) by Stephen Goldrick as one downloadable zip of about 504 MB, free under CC BY 4.0, with the related paper on monitoring and control challenges of the benchmark process. Coverage is one simulated fermenter. Caveats: the data are simulated, not plant records, and the fault batches and control strategies are described in the paper, which was not read. For simulation it gives a large, realistic process data benchmark to test soft sensors, fault detection and control of pharmaceutical production units. Related catalogue records include the Tennessee Eastman process anomaly detection data and the MIDAS ice cream factory dataset.
